notes: Three waws against two ASV connectives plus one subordinator: *And when* is one rendering of the first waw under rule 55 (headed on the coordinator, with *when* as the competing head), *and* belongs to the third, and the apodosis waw before יֵּצֵא is unrepresented under rule 14.
מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן takes a supplied *the* on the construct while מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן gives the written *the* to the rectum's article under rule 29's fronting case.
